description: This file implements a role-based selector engine for accessibility testing, including role validation, attribute handling, and querying DOM elements based on ARIA roles and attributes.

methods.name: validateSupportedRole
methods.description: Validates if a role is supported for a given ARIA attribute.

methods.name: validateSupportedValues
methods.description: Checks if attribute values are within the supported set.

methods.name: validateSupportedOp
methods.description: Ensures the operator used in attribute selector is supported.

methods.name: validateAttributes
methods.description: Validates and constructs role engine options from attribute selectors.

methods.name: queryRole
methods.description: Queries DOM elements matching specified ARIA role and attribute options.
